name: Naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories Citizen

requirement_groups.name: Applicant's mother born in the Territory

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant's mother was born in the Virgin Islands.
Applicant was granted Belonger Status under Section 16 of the Immigration and Passport Ordinance.

requirement_groups.name: Deemed to belong under the Constitution Order

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant is deemed to belong to the Virgin Islands under the Virgin Islands (Constitution) Order.

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of a British Overseas Territories Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant is the spouse of a British Overseas Territories Citizen.

requirement_groups.name: Holder of a Certificate of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant holds a Certificate of Residence.

evidence_required.document: Application form, checklist, and language requirement (collected in person)
Proof of status (Belonger Card, Residence Certificate, etc., per ground)

Fee: $150 (mother born in territory), $400 (Section 16 Belonger Status), $500 (deemed to belong under Constitution Order), $500 (spouse of BOTC), or $700 (Certificate of Residence) -- stamp and application fees combined
Attendance at naturalisation ceremony (Oath of Allegiance / Pledge of Loyalty)

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands -- Application for Naturalisation as British Overseas Territory Citizen: five eligibility categories with differentiated fees, 12-step process, ~6-month processing, naturalisation ceremony requirement

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the British Virgin Islands' initial build. This is the genuine British Overseas Territories Citizenship (BOTC) track -- distinct from the local Belonger status routes (vg_belonger_status_descent.json, vg_belonger_status_marriage.json, vg_belonger_status_residence.json) and from Residence Status (vg_residence_status.json), all of which feed INTO this route as eligibility grounds rather than being citizenship themselves. Unusually well-documented among this session's five BOTs: unlike Montserrat's, Cayman's, and Bermuda's equivalent naturalisation routes (all marked draft for lacking substantive eligibility detail beyond process/fee), this gov.vg page gives five explicit, named eligibility categories with distinct fees -- so this route is published rather than draft. citizenship_after_months (6) reflects the source's own stated ~6-month processing timeline from application to ceremony, not a residence-accrual period (the residence/status accrual itself happens under whichever feeder route -- Belonger status, Residence Status, marriage to a BOTC, etc. -- the applicant is naturalising from). The 'mother born in the territory' category is notable as a narrower, specifically matrilineal ground distinct from the general descent-based Belonger Status route -- flagged as a genuine, distinctly-fee-scheduled category rather than folded into vg_belonger_status_descent.json, since naturalisation via this ground is a different application (BOTC status) from Belonger status itself.
